summary: Static config + pytest verification for Railway CP deploy fix (removal of deploy.startCommand from railway.json so Dockerfile CMD becomes single startup source). Ran `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_railway_cp_deploy.py -o addopts='' -q` -> 7 passed, 0 failed. Verified railway.json has no deploy.startCommand and preserves healthcheckPath '/health', healthcheckTimeout=120, restartPolicyType=ON_FAILURE, restartPolicyMaxRetries=5. Verified deploy/railway/Dockerfile CMD is ["sh","-c","uvicorn cp_asgi:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8080}"] with no hardcoded 8000/8001.
critical_code_review_comments: cp_asgi.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup') - consider migrating to lifespan handlers (non-blocking, DeprecationWarning emitted during tests).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Railway CP deploy config verified. railway.json deploy block has NO startCommand (Dockerfile CMD is sole source, using ${PORT:-8080} via sh -c). All 7 tests in test_railway_cp_deploy.py pass. Only remaining minor code-quality nit: FastAPI on_event deprecation warning in cp_asgi.py.
rca of the issue: Prior regression: railway.json set deploy.startCommand='uvicorn cp_asgi:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT'. Railway executes startCommand WITHOUT a shell, so $PORT wasn't expanded and uvicorn errored: 'Invalid value for --port: $PORT is not a valid integer'. Fix: removed startCommand entirely from railway.json; Dockerfile CMD uses `sh -c` with ${PORT:-8080} so shell expansion works. Verified via file inspection and updated pytest assertions.
